result:
I replaced `sort_by(|a, b| a.slot.cmp(&b.slot))` with `sort_by_key(|a| a.slot)` at `src/booking/queries/list_guest_bookings.rs:19`, which is the change clippy suggested. I haven't re-run the build or clippy, so I haven't confirmed the error is gone.

`sort_by_key` returns the key by value, so it only compiles if `Slot` is `Copy`. Clippy's suggestion implies it is, but I didn't check the `Slot` definition. If the build now complains about moving out of `a.slot`, `Slot` isn't `Copy`. In that case use `sort_by_key(|a| a.slot.clone())` instead.
